results.title: Junior/Senior Software Engineer
results.description:
Location: Central (Hybrid)

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance full-stack applications .
  • Take ownership of features throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to implementation, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
  • Drive continuous improvements in software engineering practices, development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and automation initiatives.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure high standards of code quality, maintainability, and performance.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and user-centric solutions.
  • Support client integrations, troubleshoot technical issues, and provide timely resolution to production challenges.
  • Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, scalability, security, and development efficiency.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering best practices, coding standards, Agile methodologies, and established software delivery processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Min. 1-7 years of experience designing, building, and deploying enterprise-scale full-stack applications.
  • Hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Golang, Java, Python, or Node.js.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, including deploying and supporting cloud-native applications.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software deployment methodologies.
  • Experience working with IAC such as Terraform would be greatly advantageous
